DUPLICATE PERSON RECORD (research 2026-07-03): this record and I182541959437 are the same individual duplicated under separate internal IDs with identical data. Per Harris, A Genealogical Record of Daniel Pond (1873), pp. 29-30, entry #46, this man's own marriage is NOT recorded in the primary source — the book states only 'His wife, Dorothy, was admitted to the church at Dedham, Feb. 28, 1724-5,' with no maiden name given anywhere. The surname 'Whitney' attached to his wife in this tree (I182541966268) cannot be confirmed from that source and should be treated as unsupported/possible tree lore pending a primary Newton or Dedham vital record.
